name: Xiari Yuanyang Jiaqi
source:
The cruise ship’s horns blast. You’re going to be spending the next 10 days aboard the Distant Oceanic Cruise, a luxury vacation for sapphics only! 

Play as Maeve (customizable name), a heartbroken soul determined to move on from a cheating ex. There are only six other single sapphics on board— could one possibly be your soulmate? Only time will tell! After all, ‘tis the SEA-son for love!

[From [url=https://red-bean-taiyaki.itch.io/distant-oceanic-getaway]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
游轮的号角吹响了。接下来的10天你将在遥远的海洋游轮上度过，这是只为女同性恋者准备的豪华假期！

扮演梅芙（可定制的名字），一个伤心欲绝的灵魂，决心摆脱出轨的前任。船上只有六位单身女蓝宝石——其中一位可能是你的灵魂伴侣吗？只有时间会证明一切！毕竟，这是爱的海子！

[来自[url=https://red-bean-taiyaki.itch.io/distant-oceanic-getaway]itch.io[/url]]
